mapper.sql: ROLE_ID, ROLE_CODE, ROLE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, USE_YN, DEL_YN, REG_DT, REG_BY, MOD_DT, MOD_BY
mapper.select: SELECT FROM BSYROLE ROLE WHERE ROLE.DEL_YN='N' AND (UPPER(ROLE.ROLE_ID) LIKE CONCAT('%',UPPER(#{KEYWORD}),'%') OR UPPER(ROLE.ROLE_CODE) LIKE CONCAT('%',UPPER(#{KEYWORD}),'%') OR UPPER(ROLE.ROLE_NAME) LIKE CONCAT('%',UPPER(#{KEYWORD}),'%')) AND ROLE.USE_YN=#{USE_YN} ORDER BY ROLE.ROLE_ID
SELECT FROM BSYROLE ROLE WHERE ROLE.ROLE_ID=#{ROLE_ID} AND ROLE.DEL_YN='N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BSYROLE WHERE ROLE_ID=#{ROLE_ID}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BSYROLE ROLE WHERE ROLE.ROLE_CODE=#{ROLE_CODE} AND ROLE.ROLE_ID != #{EXCLUDE_ROLE_ID}
mapper.update: UPDATE BSYROLE ROLE SET ROLE_CODE=#{ROLE_CODE},ROLE_NAME=#{ROLE_NAME},DESCRIPTION=#{DESCRIPTION},USE_YN=#{USE_YN},MOD_DT=#{MOD_DT},MOD_BY=#{MOD_BY} WHERE ROLE.ROLE_ID=#{ROLE_ID} AND ROLE.DEL_YN='N'
UPDATE BSYROLE ROLE SET DEL_YN='Y',USE_YN='N',MOD_DT=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,MOD_BY=#{MOD_BY} WHERE ROLE.ROLE_ID=#{ROLE_ID} AND ROLE.DEL_YN='N'
mapper.select: SELECT RP.PROGRAM_ID, PROG.PROGRAM_NAME, PROG.MODULE_CODE, RP.ALLOW_YN FROM BSYROLEPROG RP JOIN BSYPROG PROG ON PROG.PROGRAM_ID = RP.PROGRAM_ID AND PROG.DEL_YN='N' WHERE RP.ROLE_ID=#{ROLE_ID} ORDER BY PROG.MODULE_CODE, PROG.PROGRAM_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BSYROLEPROG (ROLE_ID, PROGRAM_ID, ALLOW_YN, REG_BY, MOD_BY) VALUES (#{ROLE_ID},#{PROGRAM_ID},#{ALLOW_YN},#{REG_BY},#{REG_BY})
mapper.select: SELECT RB.PROGRAM_ID, RB.GROUP_CODE, BT.GROUP_NAME, RB.ALLOW_YN FROM BSYROLEBTGP RB JOIN BSYBTGP BT ON BT.PROGRAM_ID = RB.PROGRAM_ID AND BT.GROUP_CODE = RB.GROUP_CODE WHERE RB.ROLE_ID=#{ROLE_ID} ORDER BY RB.PROGRAM_ID, RB.GROUP_CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BSYROLEBTGP (ROLE_ID, PROGRAM_ID, GROUP_CODE, ALLOW_YN, REG_BY, MOD_BY) VALUES (#{ROLE_ID},#{PROGRAM_ID},#{GROUP_CODE},#{ALLOW_YN},#{REG_BY},#{REG_BY})
